category_title: Highly resistant students with autism and severe communication impairment
minimal_context: Hannah and the tutor are in an individual work session where the goal is to match words to pictures.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our individual work session. Let's match these words to the pictures.

STUDENT: (Pushes away from the table and puts her head down, withdrawing from the activity.)

TUTOR: Please sit up and look at the materials.

STUDENT: (Makes loud incessant vocalisations and takes the picture cards for herself, not allowing guidance.)

TUTOR: Let me show you how to match them. Give me the cards.

STUDENT: (Pushes the materials away, makes loud vocalisations, and begins kicking and hitting the tutor to resist the adult-set agenda.)

options.A: Reassure the student by saying "It's OK" and physically back off from the activity.
options.B: Break the word and picture matching items into smaller chunks for the student.
options.C: Instruct the student in self-regulation strategies and promote her efficacy for using them.
options.D: Encourage the student to examine the picture cards and read the matching words.
